rule: Rule P(3000): in the seed step, the MC refinement of a candidate (MC then variance stage) stops after 3,000 strict-cost evaluations with no strict gain of its best cost, keeps the first lowest-cost orientation, and makes one final evaluation of it. CMA fits, the 0.95 stop, the five candidates, the seed test 0.80, rule G1 and the grid search are unchanged. Arm S = arm G (step 9) with P(3000).
